title: Software Engineering LLMs: Why We Need Them and How Software Engineering Helps Build Them
abstract: arXiv:2610.33851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software engineering (SE) expertise can shape how coding large language models (LLMs) are trained and which engineering capabilities they acquire. We examine this role through an industrial case study of capability-focused training for a 92B-parameter coding LLM serving more than 100,000 developers. We demonstrate how established SE knowledge can guide the selection of engineering capabilities, the construction of verifiable training data, and the evaluation of model improvements. To target repository-level refactoring, we developed RefactorForge, a pipeline that combines refactoring knowledge, established SE tools, and verification techniques to construct training data. Across 306 Python repositories, RefactorForge generated 5,704 executable tasks and retained 4,572 verified teacher trajectories totaling 72.51 million tokens. translated_title: 软件工程大语言模型：为什么我们需要它们，以及软件工程如何助力构建它们
translated_abstract: 软件工程（SE）专业知识可以塑造编码大语言模型（LLMs）的训练方式以及它们所获得的工程能力。我们通过对一个服务超过10万名开发者的920亿（92B）参数编码大语言模型进行能力导向训练的工业案例研究，来考察这一角色。我们展示了成熟的软件工程知识如何指导工程能力的选择、可验证训练数据的构建，以及模型改进的评估。为了实现仓库级重构这一目标能力，我们开发了RefactorForge——一条结合重构知识、成熟软件工程工具和验证技术的流水线，用于构建训练数据。在306个Python仓库上，RefactorForge生成了5,704个可执行任务，并保留了4,572条经过验证的教师轨迹，共计7,251万个token。基于这些轨迹进行的增量式监督微调，仅占先前编码混合数据总量的0.46%……
tldr: 软件工程专业知识可有效指导编码大语言模型的能力选择、可验证训练数据构建与评估，本工业案例通过RefactorForge流水线为仓库级重构生成了4,572条经验证的教师轨迹，并以极小的数据成本微调了一个服务10万余名开发者的920亿参数编码模型。
en_tdlr: Software engineering expertise can guide capability selection, verifiable training data construction, and evaluation for coding LLMs; through the RefactorForge pipeline, the authors generated 4,572 verified teacher trajectories for repository-level refactoring to incrementally fine-tune a 92B-parameter coding model serving over 100,000 developers.
